heroHeadline: SBU Alpha Strikes Perm Refinery 1,500 km Deep; Zelensky Rejects Russia's Victory Day Truce
heroSubtitle: Ukraine's SBU Alpha drones hit Lukoil's Perm refinery — one of the deepest strikes of the war — setting the AVT-4 refining unit 'out of action' and triggering a chemical emergency alert. Zelensky publicly rejected Putin's May 9 Victory Day ceasefire as 'a few hours of safety for a parade in Moscow,' demanding a lasting peace with real security guarantees. Russia struck Odesa in two waves overnight, injuring 18 and damaging a kindergarten.
